provenance.deduplication_method: Exact normalized (entity, county) union across all 3 workbook versions; wb1 and wb2 are cell-identical across all 29 sheets; wb3 adds endpoint_readiness_check and updated TODAY()-evaluated PRA/auction statuses.

population_integrity.population_aggregation_policy: Do not sum population_2020 across rows; entities overlap hierarchically (13 statewide bodies, 19 counties, 14 cities, 79 towns, 5 CDPs, 2 tribal nations).

excluded_unverified_rollup.reason: Workbook Executive Dashboard formula =SUM(D2:D143) double-counts statewide, county, and municipal populations; excluded from dataset metrics.
